primitives.name: Expected Possession Value
primitives.verbatim_quote: Specifically, we quantify the expected outcome at every moment in a possession, driven by a fine-grained evaluation of the full spatio-temporal characteristics of the 22 players as well as the potential value of ball drives, shots, or passes to any location.
primitives.assumptions: Full spatio-temporal player tracking data assumed; possession terminates only via shot, pass, dribble, or turnover.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Possession end-events trigger singular value reset; continuous dynamics governed by Markovian transition kernels.

layer2.mapping: GSI: EPV maps to posterior predictive goal probability under conformalized neural network; GSE: EPV encodes state-action value Q(s,a) in discrete-time Markov decision process.
layer2.telemetry: Observed shot outcomes, pass completion indicators, and possession duration serve as empirical calibration metrics.

primitives.name: Passing Value Surface
primitives.verbatim_quote: Specifically, we quantify the expected outcome at every moment in a possession, driven by a fine-grained evaluation of the full spatio-temporal characteristics of the 22 players as well as the potential value of ball drives, shots, or passes to any location.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'V_p(x_a, x_d)': 'Expected goal contribution from pass from attacker at x_a to receiver at x_d'}
primitives.assumptions: Conditional independence of pass value given origin-destination coordinates; linear superposition of receiver utility across multiple pass attempts.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Pass fails if intercepted or leads to turnover; otherwise, value transfers additively to receiver's position.

layer2.mapping: GSI: V_p(x_a, x_d) estimates conditional mean outcome given pass trajectory; GSE: V_p serves as immediate-reward function R(s, a) for subsequent action-value iteration.
layer2.telemetry: Pass accuracy rate and receiver positioning relative to goal line act as leakage checks.

primitives.name: Ball Drive Kernel
primitives.verbatim_quote: Specifically, we quantify the expected outcome at every moment in a possession, driven by a fine-grained evaluation of the full spatio-temporal characteristics of the 22 players as well as the potential value of ball drives, shots, or passes to any location.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {"K_b(x, x')": "Transition density for ball movement from cell x to adjacent cell x'"}
primitives.assumptions: Dribbling follows a local random walk; kernel integrates over infinitesimal displacement under Brownian motion approximation.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Ball lost triggers immediate termination; otherwise, kernel propagates possession forward in continuous space.

layer2.mapping: GSI: K_b(x, x') quantifies plausible ball-handling trajectories under stochastic differential geometry; GSE: K_b defines transition dynamics for state-transition matrices P_{ss'}.
layer2.telemetry: Average dribble distance per possession and ball-retention percentage serve as cross-layer validation metrics.

primitives.name: Shot Value Expectation
primitives.verbatim_quote: Specifically, we quantify the expected outcome at every moment in a possession, driven by a fine-grained evaluation of the full spatio-temporal characteristics of the 22 players as well as the potential value of ball drives, shots, or passes to any location.
primitives.assumptions: Shot quality depends only on shooter location, angle, and defender proximity; shots are independent Bernoulli trials with time-varying success probability.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Shot either results in goal (+1) or non-goal (-1); all other outcomes lead to possession reset.

layer2.mapping: GSI: E[G|s] maps to post-shot expected goal (xG) under logistic regression; GSE: E[G|s] contributes terminal reward to episode return in temporal-difference learning.
layer2.telemetry: Historical shot conversion rates by zone and goalkeeper intervention frequency prevent overfitting.

reasoning_traces.think:
The core operator is a recursive Bellman decomposition of expected goal flow. At each instant, possession splits into three exclusive futures: a shot occurs with probability p_s, a pass succeeds with probability p_p, or a ball drive transitions the state with density K_b. The expected value EPV satisfies EPV = p_s * E[G|s] + p_p * V_p + ∫ K_b * EPV' dx'. This integro-differential equation is solved via deep neural networks parameterizing the constituent kernels and expectations, yielding a differentiable surrogate for optimal tactical value. Failure occurs when the decoupling violates mass conservation, i.e., total probability exceeds unity.
